title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Wood Materials
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Trees that have broad leaves and produce seeds enclosed within a fruit are generally classified as:
questions.explain: Hardwoods come from deciduous (broad-leaved) trees where seeds are enclosed in fruit (angiosperms). Examples include Mahogany and Iroko.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: An example of a softwood tree is:
questions.explain: Pine is a coniferous tree with needle-like leaves, classifying it as a softwood. The others listed are hardwoods.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which of the following is a 'Natural Defect' in timber?
questions.explain: Knots are natural defects occurring where a branch grew from the trunk. Bowing and cupping are often seasoning defects.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Plywood is a manufactured board made by:
options: Gluing thin layers (veneers) of wood together at right angles
questions.explain: Plywood is constructed by gluing veneers (thin sheets) with the grain direction of adjacent layers running perpendicular (90 degrees) to each other.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
